findings.name: Quote Order PDFs
findings.detail: Configure a PDF template to generate PDFs after creating a quoted order. You can generate, view, and edit PDFs only from the web. When a field rep completes a sale, they can capture customer's signature on the quoted order. Capturing the customer's signature gives a documented, formal record of who confirmed the order—for example, a pharmacy store manager confirming a purchase. Field reps can capture this signature directly from their iPad, whether they're online or offline. When a field rep is offline, the device encrypts and stores the signature locally, then syncs it to Salesforce after connectivity restores. The signing experience is identical online and offline, so field reps don't need to change how they capture a signature based on connectivity. Note The Quote Line Items component supports up to 700 line items for PDF generation. For handling upto 2,000 products, use the Related Record Table component to configure quote line items in the Quotes page. Create a Quote Document Template Add a digital signature component to your quote document template so field reps can capture a customer's signature at the point of sale.

title: Price Waterfall Considerations
summary: Review these considerations before you configure Price Waterfall and Price Waterfall

findings.name: Required Editions
findings.detail: Available in: Lightning Experience Available in: Enterprise and Unlimited Editions with Life Sciences Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement Add-on license, and the Life Sciences Customer Engagement managed package. Configure Open and Closed Quote Statuses first. If both the Open Quote Statuses and Closed Quote Statuses fields are empty, no waterfall data syncs to an iPad, even with Price Waterfall turned on. Include every active quote status that your org uses—including custom statuses—in either list. Enter status values that exactly match the picklist values on your Quote object, including capitalization. If the popover opens but appears empty, see Order Management Troubleshooting . Balance retention against storage. Caching waterfall data consumes on-device storage. Select longer retention so field reps can review historical quotes offline, at the cost of more storage. Select shorter retention to conserve storage, knowing reps lose access to older data offline sooner. Understand what gets cleaned up automatically. On each sync, the iPad removes waterfall data older than the configured retention period, data for quotes that aren't in a configured open or closed status, and draft waterfall data beyond the single most-recent entry per quote line item.

title: Quoted Order Sharing by Territory

findings.name: Quoted Order Sharing by Territory
findings.detail: Configure territory-based quote sharing for field reps to automatically gain visibility into all previous quoted orders for accounts in their territory. The Manage Quote Sharing batch job runs on a set schedule, evaluating territory assignments and sharing quoted orders and their related records with the correct users. Field reps can use this quote history to prepare for negotiations, compare historical pricing, and build new quoted orders faster. Because quote records in Salesforce have no relationship to territory, Salesforce derives the territory connection through the account. An account's territory assignment is the basis for determining which users receive access to an account's quotes. Users assigned to an account's territory receive visibility into that account's quotes and related records. When a quoted order is shared based on territory, these records are shared with the territory-assigned field rep. Quotes: Primary shared record linked to an account via territory assignment. Drives sharing of all child records. Quote Line Items: Line-level detail from a shared quoted order. Helps field reps to see line-level detail from previous quoted orders. Quote Line Price Adjustments: Historical pricing discounts applied to a quoted order. Helps field reps compare historical pricing discounts. Territory-based quoted orders sharing is available on both web and iPads. Add Account to Quotes Record Page When creating a quoted order, field reps select an account, and can then see quoted orders for other accounts in their territory.

findings.detail: Configure a workflow on the Quote object to control when quotes and their child records—Quote Line Items and Quote Line Groups—lock, based on the quote's status. The workflow also defines the actions that users can take at each stage. Locking a quote prevents unauthorized changes during critical workflow stages.

findings.name: Required Editions
findings.detail: User Permissions Needed To set up the workflow: | Life Sciences Commercial Admin permission set Create the Submit and Request for Unlock actions that appear as buttons on the Quote record page. See Create Workflow Actions . Define the stages that a quote passes through and which actions are available at each stage. See Create a Workflow Path . Show reps and managers the quote's current stage. See Add the Workflow Path Component to the Quote Record Page . Make sure reps change a quote's status only through the workflow action buttons. See Restrict the Quote Status Field for Field Reps . Turn on the trigger that runs the workflow. See Enable the Workflow Trigger . Grant the sharing access reps must use stage actions. See Get Your Org Ready for Quote and Pricing Users . Create Workflow Actions Before configuring stages, create the two workflow actions that appear as buttons on the Quote record page. Create a Workflow Path Create a workflow path on the Quote object and configure the Draft, Submitted, and Request for Unlock stages to control when quotes are locked and unlocked. Add the Workflow Path Component to the Quote Record Page Add the LifeSciStagePathContainer lightning component to see the workflow path details on the Quote record page. This component shows all stages and stage operation actions configured in a workflow path. Restrict the Quote Status Field for Field Reps To restrict field reps from manually changing a quote's status, set the Status field on a quote as read-only. This makes sure a quote's status changes only through the workflow action buttons. Turn on the Workflow Trigger For triggering the workflow, turn on the StagePathPermissionsHandler trigger.

Approving the request unlocks the quote and returns its status to Draft, so your field reps can edit and resubmit. Rejecting the request changes the status to Rejected and keeps the quote locked. Either way, the flow notifies the field rep of the outcome.

findings.name: Create a Quoted Order from Web
findings.detail: Field reps build quoted orders directly from the web by selecting an account, browsing a price book, and adding products from the catalog. Set quantities and discounts at the line level, or apply a header-level adjustment across the entire quote using a percentage or fixed amount. Generate a PDF to review, edit, or email before submitting the quote for approval, keeping the sales cycle moving without leaving the browser.

findings.name: Required Editions
findings.detail: Available in: Lightning Experience Available in: Enterprise and Unlimited Editions with Life Sciences Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement Add-on license, and the Life Sciences Customer Engagement managed package. User Permissions Needed To create a quoted order from web: | Life Sciences Commercial User permission set From the App Launcher, find and select Quote . Click New Quote . Enter a name. Select an account. Select a billing contact type and then select a shipping contact type. Save your changes. Select Browse Catalog , and then select a price book. Click Next . Select a catalog, and then click Next . Search for and add products. To add products manually, perform the following. Select Related . Select Add Product . Select the products, and click Next . Enter quantities and discount percentage for all the selected products. Save your changes. When you edit line items, save your quote to see the updated prices, discounts, and totals. To apply a header-level discount, select Manage Header Adjustment . Select the adjustment type as either Percentage or Amount . If you select Percentage, enter a value. If you select Amount, select a distribution logic, and then a value. Click Apply . To apply a manual discount at the line level, for the line item you want to add a discount, perform the following. Select the adjustment type as either Percentage or Amount . If you select Percentage, enter a value. If you select Amount, select a distribution logic, and then a value. Save your changes and submit the quoted order. Click Generate PDF . You can view, edit, and email the PDF. Click Submit . Quoted orders created on the web syncs to its territory. So, field reps can see orders, even the ones created on the web, for their territories on their iPads.

findings.name: Create a Quoted Order from iPad
findings.detail: From an iPad, create quoted orders from multiple pages. Field reps typically create quoted orders after they complete a store check.

findings.name: Required Editions
findings.detail: Available in: Lightning Experience Available in: Enterprise and Unlimited Editions with Life Sciences Cloud, Life Sciences Cloud for Customer Engagement Add-on license, and the Life Sciences Customer Engagement managed package. You can create quotes from a mobile device from these pages. Account related list Visit record The Quoted Orders tab in Visits Visit related list Quoted Order You can start a quoted order from any of these pages. These steps show the most common path from a visit. User Permissions Needed To create a quoted order from iPad: | Life Sciences Commercial User permission set From the iPad's homepage, go to the Visits tab. Select Quoted Orders . Enter the quote details, such as the account and billing information. The fields appear based on the page layout configured by your admin. Save your changes. Select Add line items . Select a price book, and then click Continue to select products . Select products. You can select one of these options. Products from Last Order Store Assortments Add products manually Click Continue . To see all products, select All Products . The list shows only the products with a list price currency that matches the currency you selected as quote currency. If you don't select a quote currency, products matching the currency specified for your profile are shown instead. If no product matches either currency, no products are shown. To see priority products, select Priority Products . The product list shows up only if your Salesforce admin has set up a store assortment for the account. Select the products you want to add in the quoted order, and click Add to quote . Products aren't grouped by either category or brand in the browse catalog products. Enter quantities for each product. Pricing gets calculated automatically. To add a manual discount to a quote line item, perform these steps. Select the discount type. You can select either Amount or Percentage . Enter the value, and click Apply . When you edit line items, save your quote to see the updated prices, discounts, and totals. To apply a header-level discount, perform these steps. For Order Discount at the bottom of the page, click Add . Select the discount type. These are the available options. Amount Percentage Override Total Enter the value. If you select Amount, select a distribution type. Click Apply . Hover over a quote line item to view its detailed, step-by-step price breakdown. Depending on how pricing is configured, you can access this breakdown in both online and offline modes, or exclusively while online. To verify the added details, click Review . If a disclaimer is configured, it appears on the screen. If configured, add your signature.
